name: Gwibble (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-02: The Mosquito Witch

items.name: Dart
items.description: This thrown weapon is larger than an arrow but shorter than a javelin. It typically has a short shaft of wood ending in a metal tip and is sometimes stabilized by feathers or fur.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

items.name: Black Adder Venom
items.description:
Adder venom is a simple but effective way to enhance a weapon.

Activate Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 3 rounds

Stage 1 1d8 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d10 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 poison damage (1 round)

generalAbilities.name: Self-Loathing
generalAbilities.description: A mitflit's self-loathing makes it easy to influence. It takes a -4 penalty to its Will DC against checks to Coerce, Demoralize, Make an Impression, and Request.

generalAbilities.name: Vermin Empathy
generalAbilities.description: Mitflits can use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on and Request things of arthropods (insects, spiders, scorpions, crabs, and similar invertebrate animals). Most arthropods have a starting attitude of Indifferent to mitflits.

offensiveAbilities.name: Baleful Blade
offensiveAbilities.description: Any creature affected by the Bane spell is Off-Guard to Gwibble.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hidden Movement
offensiveAbilities.description: If Gwibble starts his turn Undetected by a creature or merely Hidden from it, that creature is Off-Guard against Gwibble's attacks until the end of Gwibble's turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Gwibble deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vengeful Anger
offensiveAbilities.description: As long as it isn't Frightened, a mitflit gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls against a creature that has previously damaged or tormented it.

cantrips.name: Prestidigitation
cantrips.description:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

lv1spells.name: Bane
lv1spells.description:
You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt.

Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area.

Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bane, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract Bless.

lv2spells.name: Speak with Animals (At Will) (Arthropods only)
lv2spells.description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.
